'''Eckehard Schöll''' (born 6 February 1951) is a German [[physicist]] and [[mathematician]] as well as a  [[professor]] of [[theoretical physics]] at [[Technische Universität Berlin]]. He is an expert in the field of [[nonlinear dynamics]] and head of the group Nonlinear dynamics and control.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/schoell/nlds/home// |title=AG Nichtlineare Dynamik und Kontrolle: AG Schöll |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date=2012-09-20 |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref> His work pertains to research in the fields of mathematics and physics, particularly [[semiconductor physics]], neurodynamics and bifurcation theory. His latest research is also related to topics in biology and the social sciences, e.g.  simulation of the dynamics in  socioeconomic or neuronal networks.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1038/nphys1611 | volume=6 | issue=3 | title=Neural control: Chaos control sets the pace | journal=Nature Physics | pages=161–162| bibcode=2010NatPh...6..161S | last1=Schöll | first1=Eckehard | year=2010 }}</ref> 
He is one of the forerunners into the research of chimera states.

Eckehard Schöll is the author of over 580 publications in scientific journals,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/schoell/nlds/forschung/veroeffentlichungen/ |title=AG Nichtlineare Dynamik und Kontrolle: Veröffentlichungen |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date=2011-12-09 |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref> three books (''Nonequilibrium Phase Transitions in Semiconductors'' (Springer 1987), ''The Physics of Instabilities in Solid State Electron Devices'' (Plenum Press, New York, 1992), and ''Nonlinear Spatio-Temporal Dynamics and Chaos in Semiconductors'' ([[Cambridge University Press]] 2001)) as well as editor of several books.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/schoell/nlds/forschung/veroeffentlichungen/books/ |title=AG Nichtlineare Dynamik und Kontrolle: Books |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date= |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref> His [[Hirsch index]] is 76 (as of 2023) and his [[Einstein number]] is 5.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/schoell/nlds/mitglieder/arbeitsgruppenleiter/schoell/scientific_genealogy_and_einstein_number/ |title=AG Nichtlineare Dynamik und Kontrolle: Scientific genealogy and Einstein number |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date= |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref>

==Life and career==
[[File:2009StreikVL.jpg|thumbnail|Eckehard Schöll 2009 at a protest lecture  in front of the Roten Rathaus during the students strike.]]
Since 1989  Eckehard Schöll is [[professor|Hochschulprofessor]] at Technische Universität Berlin where to date he has supervised 100 [[Diplom]]-, Master- und Bachelor theses, 30 PhD theses und 2 habilitations. He studied physics at the [[University of Tübingen]] (Diplom 1976) and graduated with a PhD in mathematics in 1978 from the [[University of Southampton]] (UK, doctoral advisor P. T. Landsberg). He completed a [[Dr. rer. nat.]] in 1981 under the supervision of Friedrich Schlögl at the [[RWTH Aachen University]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/schoell/nlds/mitglieder/arbeitsgruppenleiter/ |title=AG Nichtlineare Dynamik und Kontrolle: Arbeitsgruppenleiter |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date= |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref> He was a visiting assistant professor at the [[Wayne State University]] in Detroit, USA (1983–1984) and afterwards a guest scientist at the [[University of Florida]], USA (1985). He finished is [[habilitation]] in 1986. He has been involved in several collaborative research centers and was head of the [[Collaborative Research Centers|collaborative research center]] SFB 910 of the [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft]] (DFG) with the topic ''Control of Self-Organizing Nonlinear Systems''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/sfb910/sonderforschungsbereich_910/sonderforschungsbereich_910/ |title=SFB910: Sonderforschungsbereich 910 |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date= |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref> Eckehard Schöll is involved with the [[Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes]], and part of the election committee of the [[Fulbright Program]]. Since 2020 he is Guest Scientist at [[Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pik-potsdam.de/members/eschoell |title=PIK Members: Eckehard Schöll |publisher=Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK) |accessdate=2023-07-12}}</ref>

Eckehard Schöll is married with two children and has one grandchild.

==Awards and distinctions==
[[File:2007RWTHAachen.jpg|thumbnail|2007 25th PhD Anniversary of Eckehard Schöll, Presentation of the Renewal Certificate]]
Eckehard Schöll was scholar of Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes between 1971 und 1978. In 1997 he was awarded ''champion of teaching'' from TU Berlin for his well structured and informative lectures.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://archiv.pressestelle.tu-berlin.de/pi/1997/pi245.htm |title=TU Berlin – Medieninformation Nr. 245 – 10. November 1997 |website=Archiv.pressestelle.tu-berlin.de |date= |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref> In 2000 he received a Fulbright Senior Scholarship Award (Duke University, USA), as well as a Visiting Professorship of the [[London Mathematical Society]] in 2004. In 2017 he was awarded an honorary doctorate of the [[Saratov State University]], Russia.

===Conferences===
Being an active member of the scientific community, Eckehard Schöll has been involved in the organization of several international scientific conferences<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.itp.tu-berlin.de/schoell/nlds/mitglieder/arbeitsgruppenleiter/schoell/cv/ |title=AG Nichtlineare Dynamik und Kontrolle: CV |website=Itp.tu-berlin.de |date= |accessdate=2016-02-11}}</ref>
* Short Thematic Program on Delay Differential Equations, Toronto 2015,
* Control of Self-Organizing Nonlinear Systems, Warnemünde 2014,
* Delayed Complex Systems, Palma de Mallorca 2012
* Delayed Complex Systems, Dresden 2009
* Local conference director of the 72., 76., and 79. [[Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft|DPG]]-Spring Meeting of the condensed matter section in Berlin

'''Main research'''
* Dynamics of networks, synchronization patterns and Chimera-states
* [[Chaos theory|Chaos]] and noise in dynamical systems
* Analysis of dynamical systems with time delay and the control thereof.
* Nonlinear dynamics of semiconductor lasers
* Nonlinear carrier transport in semiconductor nanosstructures
* Self organization, growth kinetics and Monte-Carlo-simulations
